claims.claim: Lilly broke ground September 21 on a $6.5B Houston API facility within a stated $50B U.S. manufacturing expansion; the project is intended to support Foundayo and other small-molecule medicines, making manufacturing ramp, commissioning and demand conversion a source-addressed execution dependency rather than assuming capacity arrives immediately.

risks.risk: Large multi-year manufacturing commitments create execution, commissioning and capital-allocation exposure if construction, qualification or product demand develops differently than planned.

falsifiers: On-time qualification and ramp with sustained demand, supply reliability and acceptable returns on incremental capacity would reduce this execution/capital-allocation risk.

unknowns.unknown: Facility commissioning schedule, utilization ramp and incremental return profile are not established by the groundbreaking announcement.
